summary.reply_metric_interpretation: Number of replies reported by platform, not contents or number of distinct repliers
summary.confidence_note: High replies are an interaction signal (debate, question, humor, conversation etc.); not automatic proof of dispute

thresholds.definition: 75th percentile of NON-MISSING values in collected sample; high requires >0
thresholds.warning: Relative bins depend on returned sample and ties; NOT platform-wide rankings or representative proportions

interpretation_hypotheses_to_check.高赞低回复: 可能更易获得快速认同、情绪共鸣或一句话总结；也可能因曝光排序产生，须读正文确认
interpretation_hypotheses_to_check.低赞高回复: 可能是提问、讨论、争论、纠错、互动游戏或作者参与；不能只凭回复数认定有争议
interpretation_hypotheses_to_check.高赞高回复: 可能兼具传播认可和持续讨论；要检查回复内容才知道讨论态度
interpretation_hypotheses_to_check.低赞低回复: 可能较少曝光，也可能互动吸引力低；不可直接认定评论无价值
interpretation_hypotheses_to_check.指标缺失_不能分类: 平台未返回至少一项指标，不参与高低比较
